{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for converted customers AND valid age (exclude -1)
converted_customers = df[(df['converted'] == 1) & (df['customer_age'] != -1)]

# Compute mean age
mean_age = converted_customers['customer_age'].mean()

print(f"Number of converted customers with valid age: {len(converted_customers)}")
print(f"Mean age of converted customers: {mean_age:.2f}")"}
